questions.question: What is the total revenue generated from customers in the USA?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.country = 'USA';

questions.question: List the names of suppliers whose products are currently 'In Transit'.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN shipments sh ON oi.order_id = sh.order_id WHERE sh.status = 'In Transit';

questions.question: Which customer has the highest total order value?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many items from Asian suppliers were delivered successfully?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id JOIN shipments sh ON oi.order_id = sh.order_id WHERE s.region = 'Asia' AND sh.status = 'Delivered';

questions.question: List the names of products that have never been ordered.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items);

questions.question: What is the total cost of treatments for patients over 50 years old?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(t.cost) FROM patients p JOIN appointments a ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id JOIN treatments t ON a.appt_id = t.appt_id WHERE p.age > 50;

questions.question: Which department has generated the most treatment revenue?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name FROM departments d JOIN doctors doc ON d.dept_id = doc.dept_id JOIN appointments a ON doc.doctor_id = a.doctor_id JOIN treatments t ON a.appt_id = t.appt_id GROUP BY d.dept_id ORDER BY SUM(t.cost) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: List patients who have seen doctors in the Neurology department.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM patients p JOIN appointments a ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id JOIN doctors d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id JOIN departments dept ON d.dept_id = dept.dept_id WHERE dept.name = 'Neurology';

questions.question: Find the average treatment cost per doctor.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(t.cost) FROM doctors d JOIN appointments a ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id JOIN treatments t ON a.appt_id = t.appt_id GROUP BY d.doctor_id;

questions.question: Count the number of appointments that didn't result in any treatments.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN treatments t ON a.appt_id = t.appt_id WHERE t.treatment_id IS NULL;

questions.question: What is the average number of credits taken by students majoring in Computer Science?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(c.credits) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN departments d ON s.major_dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science';

questions.question: Which professor has given the most 'A' grades?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p.name FROM professors p JOIN courses c ON p.prof_id = c.prof_id JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.grade = 'A' GROUP BY p.prof_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: List all students who are taking courses outside their major department.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN professors p ON c.prof_id = p.prof_id WHERE s.major_dept_id != p.dept_id;

questions.question: Find the total number of distinct courses offered by the Mathematics department.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) FROM courses c JOIN professors p ON c.prof_id = p.prof_id JOIN departments d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.name = 'Mathematics';

questions.question: Show the names of students who have not enrolled in any courses.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments);

questions.question: What is the total revenue generated by Delta airlines?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(t.price) FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id JOIN tickets t ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id WHERE a.name = 'Delta';

questions.question: List the names of passengers flying to Dubai.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p.name FROM passengers p JOIN tickets t ON p.passenger_id = t.passenger_id JOIN flights f ON t.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN airports a ON f.dest_airport = a.airport_code WHERE a.city = 'Dubai';

questions.question: Which airport serves as the source for the longest flight by duration?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT a.airport_code FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_code = f.src_airport ORDER BY f.duration_mins DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Find the average ticket price for flights departing from the USA.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(t.price) FROM tickets t JOIN flights f ON t.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN airports a ON f.src_airport = a.airport_code WHERE a.country = 'USA';

questions.question: Count how many tickets were sold for each airline.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(t.ticket_id) FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id JOIN tickets t ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id GROUP BY a.airline_id;

questions.question: What is the total balance of all accounts in the Boston branch?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(a.balance) FROM accounts a JOIN branches b ON a.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE b.city = 'Boston';

questions.question: Which customer has the highest loan amount?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN loans l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: List all customers who have made a Withdrawal transaction.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON c.account_id = a.account_id JOIN transactions t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.tx_type = 'Withdrawal';

questions.question: Find the average interest rate of loans for customers at the New York branch.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(l.interest_rate) FROM loans l JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN accounts a ON c.account_id = a.account_id JOIN branches b ON a.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE b.city = 'New York';

questions.question: Count the number of deposits made by each customer.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(t.tx_id) FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON c.account_id = a.account_id JOIN transactions t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.tx_type = 'Deposit' GROUP BY c.customer_id;
